explain:
When you press Run
  Repeat 100 times:
    Click left at 50% across, 50% down the screen
    Wait 250ms
Stops automatically after 10m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Run
  Repeat until stopped:
    Click left at 30% across, 40% down the screen
    Wait 500ms
    Click left at 50% across, 40% down the screen
    Wait 500ms
    Click left at 70% across, 40% down the screen
    Wait 500ms
Stops automatically after 10m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Run
  Set __easyStart = now()
  Repeat while now() - __easyStart < 300000:
    Press Space ×1
    Wait 200ms
Stops automatically after 6m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Ctrl+Alt+S
  Type “Best regards,
{{name}}
{{date()}}”
Stops automatically after 10m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Run
  For each row in split(rows, "|"):
    Set fields = split(row, ";")
    Type “{{fields[0]}}”
    Press Tab ×1
    Type “{{fields[1]}}”
    Ask: “Submit {{fields[0]}}?”
    If submit:
      Press Enter ×1
    Wait 1.5s
Stops automatically after 10m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

Every 20m
  Show notification “Eye break”
Stops automatically after 10m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Run
  Repeat until stopped:
    Move the pointer to 50% across, 50% down the screen
    Move the pointer to 51% across, 50% down the screen
    Wait 1m
Stops automatically after 2h · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Run
  Write to the run log: Smoke test started at {{time()}}
  Try:
    Click left at 20% across, 10% down the screen
    Wait 800ms
    Click left at 50% across, 60% down the screen
  If something fails:
    Write to the run log: Failed: {{err}}
    Show notification “Smoke test failed”
  Write to the run log: Smoke test finished
Stops automatically after 10m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Run
  Repeat until stopped:
    Scroll by (0, 120)
    Wait 4s
Stops automatically after 1h · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press F8
  Press and hold left at the current pointer position for 1000 ms
Stops automatically after 10m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Run
  Repeat until stopped:
    Drag from 50% across, 75% down the screen to 50% across, 30% down the screen
    Wait 6s
Stops automatically after 30m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When charging starts
  If hour() >= 22 || hour() < 5:
    Show notification “Wind down”
    Open app com.google.android.deskclock
Stops automatically after 10m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Run
  Open app msedge.exe
  Wait 1.5s
  Move window msedge.exe
  Open app code
  Wait 2s
  Move window Code.exe
  Open app wt.exe
Stops automatically after 10m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

Every 10m
  Try:
    Send GET request to https://example.com
  If something fails:
    Show notification “Site check failed”
Stops automatically after 10m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Ctrl+Alt+V
  Read the clipboard into clip
  Set clip = replace(replace(clip, "\n", " "), "  ", " ")
  Copy text to the clipboard
  Show notification “Clipboard cleaned”
Stops automatically after 10m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Run
  Show notification “Focus started”
  Wait 25m
  Show notification “Time for a break”
Stops automatically after 26m 40s · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Run
Plays on the second display; pauses as soon as you move the mouse
  Set collected = 0
  Repeat while collected < rounds, at most once every 400ms:
    In the lobby: start a round
      Click left at 50% across, 68% down the screen
    Reward screen: collect it
      Click left at 50% across, 76% down the screen
      Set collected = collected + 1
      Write to the run log: Collected round {{collected}} of {{rounds}}
  Show notification “Idle run finished”
Stops automatically after 30m · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Run
Plays on the second display; pauses as soon as you move the mouse
  Repeat until stopped, at most once every 500ms:
    If 50% across, 68% down the screen shows #2ecc71:
      Click left at 50% across, 68% down the screen
      Write to the run log: Ready button clicked at {{time()}}
Stops automatically after 1h · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape

When you press Run
  Repeat until stopped, at most once every 24h:
    Click left at 50% across, 76% down the screen
    Show notification “Daily check-in done”
    Write to the run log: Checked in on {{date()}}
Stops automatically after 168h · emergency stop Ctrl+Alt+Escape
